## 1. Start with the inspection records.

Start by reviewing the audit report and inspect documentation. Notes should include

*   **Date and Time:** Record when the audit was conducted.
*   **Auditor(s):** List the names and titles of the auditors.
*   **Location:** Document the specific area(s) inspected.
*   **Standard(s) Used:** Note the safety standards, regulations, or company policies against which the audit was conducted (e.g., OSHA, ANSI, ISO 45001).
*   **Initial Observations:** Briefly summarize any initial findings or areas of concern noticed during the walk-through.
